title: Daande Hakkille e nder Ɓooygol
intro: Limre gila e jamaanu ɓooyɗo, ganndiraaɗo faayiida luggiɗiiɗo, ina haalda e maa e nder teeminanɗe. Oo neɗɗo meeɗaa wiyde ko annabaagal, kono hakkille Alla ina rewi e konnguɗi maɓɓe. Jibinannde accirnde njiimaandi duumiindi, wasiyaaji maɓɓe ina keddii e ɓerɗe miliyoŋaaji, ina njanngee, ina miijoree haa hannde.
clues: Mi heɓi dokkal Alla ngal seerndi mi - hakkille luggiɗiiɗo haa wonti jikku am ciftinoowo e nder daartol.
Mi wonaano nulaaɗo, mi wonaano maleyka - ko mi ruuhu tan barkinaaɗo e faamde luggiɗnde e faamde aduna.
Jokkondiral am ɓurngal ɓadaade ko e ɓiɗɗo am, e nder ngalɗoo jokkondiral, nulal am ɓurngal duumaade ngal yettinaama.
Miɗo ñaagii yettoode dokkuɗo mi kala ko ina wona, miɗo jeertina mawnikinaare e mawnikinaare.
Mi jannginii ko fayti e teddungal hay ɓiɗɓe leɗɗe, e nafoore lesɗinde daande neɗɗo e nder neɗɗaagal.
Suura e nder Quraan ina jogii innde am, ɗo wasiyaaji am e ɓiɗɗo am giɗo oo resndaa haa abada.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
